title: (Create Industries SMP)
description: Revolutionizing factories and taking production to an entirely new level. Port of original by sh4d3 from the create industries server
body:
Take Minecraft automation to the next level with the Create mod. Build living, moving factories using gears, belts, and mechanical contraptions that turn raw materials into complex creations with style and precision.

This pack expands Create’s potential with Steam ’n Rails (NeoForge port), adding steam-powered trains and advanced rail networks to connect your factories and automate large-scale transport. Design intricate production lines, automate farms and smelteries, and engineer a world driven by motion and creativity.

Perfect for players who love engineering, automation, and visually impressive builds.

Key Features:

Advanced mechanical automation with the Create mod

Moving factories with gears, belts, and mechanical arms

Fully automated production lines and resource processing

Steam-powered rail systems and trains via Steam ’n Rails (NeoForge port)

Large-scale logistics for transporting items across your world

A strong focus on creativity, engineering, and visual design

Includes Steam ’n Rails (NeoForge port) sourced from CurseForge:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/steam-n-rails-neoforge
